description: This file defines a NotificationManager class for handling Android notifications related to repository and app updates within the org.fdroid.fdroid package.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A class managing Android notifications for repository and app updates, including showing, canceling, and creating notifications with progress and intent handling.

methods.name: showUpdateRepoNotification
methods.description: Displays a repository update notification with optional throttling and progress indicator.

methods.name: getRepoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for repository updates, with optional message and progress.

methods.name: getAppUpdateNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for app updates, with optional message.

methods.name: showAppUpdatesAvailableNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating available app updates, with intent to open MainActivity.

methods.name: getAppUpdatesAvailableNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification builder for available app updates, including title, text, and intent.
